# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Normalized carbonate-derived caches on load by re-running the carbonate solver from canonical DIC/alkalinity/temperature totals in `SaveFile::from_value`, and updated load-time stability reconciliation so repaired saves align `prev_ph` without wiping existing instability history. Added an end-of-day carbonate refresh in the daily shrimp pipeline so shrimp-driven DIC changes no longer leave persisted/snapshotted `ph` and `bicarbonate_mg_total` stale. Added regression coverage for stale current-schema saves and for 24-hour shrimp-cycle carbonate consistency.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Inspect save/load carbonate normalization gaps, shrimp DIC mutation paths, and existing regression coverage.
1. [Completed] Implement load-time carbonate cache normalization and stability-tracker reconciliation for repaired saves.
2. [Completed] Refresh carbonate caches after the daily shrimp phase so shrimp DIC mutations cannot leave stale `ph`/`bicarbonate` in snapshots or saves.
3. [Completed] Add regression tests and run targeted validation for stale-save repair and shrimp-cycle carbonate consistency.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load current_schema_load_repairs_stale_carbonate_caches -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_feeding_pathway daily_shrimp_refreshes_cached_carbonate_state -- --exact` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed (13 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed (8 tests).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` failed only at `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs::hatch_produces_juveniles`; all save-load, chemistry, and shrimp-feeding-pathway validations relevant to this fix passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core` is not fully green because `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs::hatch_produces_juveniles` still fails outside the touched carbonate-fix paths.
- The worktree already had unrelated local changes in `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs` and an untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory; they were left untouched.
